Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-09-2026.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PGIMER Senior Consultant (Assistant Professor) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 05 September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Consultant (Assistant Professor) position announced by PGIMER in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD in Psychiatry or an equivalent qualification, along with three years of experience in Psychiatry after obtaining the MD degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Senior Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this PGIMER job?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their application and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DT000354.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Chandigarh, at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER).

faq.question: Q10. Does PGIMER offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for further information.
